newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT says hopes for decision on breakup by mid-Dec.
newsitem.headline: NTT says hopes for decision on breakup by mid-Dec.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) hopes to reach some kind of agreement with the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry by the middle of December on whether to break up the company, NTT president Junichiro Miyazu said on Wednesday.
Miyazu, speaking at a regular news conference, declined to comment on how NTT would be realigned or whether the discussions were progressing in the direction of setting up a holding company.
"Establishing a holding company is one option," he said without elaborating.

Miyazu also said NTT and the Posts Ministry will reveal in mid-December a rough outline of NTT's future corporate structure, including the conditions necessary to set up such a structure. He added, however, that this might not be the final plan.
